status: Chrome owns and cleans its native temporary files as well as its profile. Deterministic failing-before regression and native smoke pass on both hosts/runtimes; matching full CI is pending.

witnessedFailure.leftoverKind: Native org.chromium.Chromium.* directory in the borrowed temporary parent; all preceding image comparisons were exact.

cause: ChromeProcess owned only the user-data profile. Chromium may create additional native files under TMPDIR, outside that profile.
change: One unique short launch root contains the profile and receives TMPDIR/TEMP/TMP. Startup failure and disposal clean only that owned root after process/pipe shutdown. Absolute parent/child validation preserves the borrowed parent and sibling owners. The short leaf keeps Linux socket paths bounded.
regression: Linux fake native startup records TMPDIR and creates a scratch child only inside the test-owned parent. The old launcher fails the ownership assertion; the fixed launcher cleans both profile and scratch. Windows retains its native smoke coverage.
